title: Zero and successor steps for open lower-shriek filtration
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure], $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a separated finite-type curve of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], $a:V\to Y$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], $r$ prime, and $R=\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf Z/r\mathbf Z)$. Let $W_i$ be sheaves of $R$-modules on $V_{\mathrm{et}}$, with arrows $\iota_i:W_i\to W_{i+1}$, $W_0$ zero, and for every $i<n$ a monomorphism $\iota_i$ with cokernel isomorphic to the constant sheaf $R$. If the eight assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] hold for $a_!R$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], then they hold for $a_!W_0$, and for each $i<n$ the assertions for $a_!W_i$ imply those for $a_!W_{i+1}$. No terminal isomorphism, cover, compactification or finite pushforward is assumed.

proof.text: Exact additive extension by zero sends W0 to zero. Its underlying abelian sheaf and all pullbacks are zero, so cohomology is subsingleton in every degree, finite, and all relevant comparison maps are bijective or surjective.

For a monic inclusion form the short exact cokernel sequence and apply exact extension by zero. The given cokernel isomorphism identifies the outer quotient with a_! R. Transport its assertions along the isomorphism and use short-exact assertion devissage with the preceding term. The prime ring is Noetherian.

theorem open_lowerShriek_constant_filtration_steps
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {Y V : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve g] (a : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion a]
    (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime] (n : ℕ)
    (W : ℕ → Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))))
    (ι : ∀ i, W i ⟶ W (i + 1)) (hzero : IsZero (W 0))
    (hquot : ∀ i < n, Mono (ι i) ∧ Nonempty (cokernel (ι i) ≅
      (constantSheaf V.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))).obj
        (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))))
    (hconstant : Assertions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) g
      ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) a).obj
        ((constantSheaf V.smallEtaleTopology
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))).obj
          (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))))) :
    Assertions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) g
      ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) a).obj
        (W 0)) ∧
    ∀ i < n,
      Assertions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) g
        ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) a).obj
          (W i)) →
      Assertions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) g
        ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) a).obj
          (W (i + 1)))
